opener_concept: Party bags: split 12 sweets and 18 stickers into the MOST identical bags with none left over. The largest number of bags (6) is the HCF of 12 and 18; each bag holds 2 sweets and 3 stickers. Reveal names this as factorising: 12x + 18 = 6(2x + 3).
